40l-chemical-dosing-tank.shortDescription: 40L square polyethylene chemical dosing tank for compact water-treatment, chemical storage and dosing applications.
40l-chemical-dosing-tank.description:
A **40L square polyethylene chemical dosing tank** designed for compact water-treatment, chemical storage and dosing installations. Its space-efficient square footprint makes it practical where installation space is limited.

- 40L nominal capacity
- Approx. 340 × 380 mm footprint
- Approx. 390 mm overall height
- Approx. 150 mm top port
- Rotationally moulded polyethylene construction
- Smooth square profile
features: Suitable for compatible water-treatment dosing applications
recommendedFor: Compatible chlorine, antiscalant and pH-dosing applications

compliance.note: Confirm chemical compatibility and site-specific requirements for the stored chemical and installation.

60l-chemical-dosing-tank.shortDescription: 60L square polyethylene chemical dosing tank for compact commercial water-treatment, chemical storage and dosing applications.
60l-chemical-dosing-tank.description:
A **60L square polyethylene chemical dosing tank** for water-treatment, chemical storage and dosing installations. It keeps the same compact 340 × 380 mm footprint as the 40L model while providing additional vertical capacity.

- 60L nominal capacity
- Approx. 340 × 380 mm footprint
- Approx. 550 mm overall height
- Approx. 150 mm top port
- Rotationally moulded polyethylene construction
- Tall square profile
features: Compact square footprint with increased capacity
Suitable for compatible water-treatment dosing applications
recommendedFor: Compatible chlorine, antiscalant and pH-dosing applications

compliance.note: Confirm chemical compatibility and site-specific requirements for the stored chemical and installation.
